statusVocabulary.tested: an automated test or recorded evidence exercises it
statusVocabulary.approved: the owner reviewed and approved it
statusVocabulary.blocked: cannot be completed without an owner decision or an external system

note: Only disciplines this build touches are mapped. A row without 'approved' means the owner has not yet signed it off; nothing here claims production readiness.
